# Bid the stories and the downspouts, not the linear feet.

> Price a gutter cleaning visit from linear feet, stories, roof pitch, gutter guards, debris, and downspouts — then loaded wage, travel, disposal, a minimum stop charge, and an optional spring-and-fall contract.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
